definition-changed.answer: 2002: '... expected to be received by a particular subprogram ...' (§2002:4); 2023: '... by a particular called program ...' (§2023:3.148). 2002 never defines 'subprogram' and uses it for a called program, so the same definitions are prototypes in both editions and the rule's scope is unchanged.

cross-reference.answer: Read §2002:8.13 whole: the same thirteen information items as §2023:8.13, ending 'any other information that the implementor requires', the same signature definition and the same two mechanism sentences (update; flag differences). 2002 adds an opening sentence naming the source units the repository holds and points at 12.2.7 where 2023 points at 12.3.8; neither changes what compiling a prototype must publish.
